name: r1g_DrawTexSpr
notes: regargs: s=ESI; calls 0x000134E0 and 0x00013AA0 without arguments

name: r1g_DrawGradStrip
notes: zero-extended 16-bit counts compared against 2 unsigned by modern cl (signed in the original; identical for 0..65535) and the k-1 >= 0 loop guard tested with test/js instead of dec/js (same sign decision)

name: r1g_CharUnitAllocFrom
notes: calls 0x0001E850 with EAX=unit EDI=counts array; returns 0 (EAX) only on the early exit and leaves EAX undefined otherwise so it is recovered as void

name: r1g_CharUnitAttach
notes: regargs: p1=stack u p2=stack tmpl p3=EDX c; original keeps the found unit in a stack slot that is left unset when the link has no target (recovered as the incoming c)

name: r1g_BatchBegin
notes: calls 0x0003A020 with EAX=p EBX=matrix; the 0x001B2A10 call moved before the three global stores in each case (it only writes 0x0040F324) to stop modern cl merging the calls

name: r1g_BlkTake
notes: regargs: low=EAX b=ECX size=EBX; in the low path the three header stores are written before the final list append (the append only touches list nodes) to stop modern cl merging the two appends
